summary: Discovered that node1 had two spare, unconfigured NICs (eth1, eth2) and node2/node3 each had a spare unconfigured NIC (ens7) forming the actual lan-a/lan-b links (the default management network at 10.100.217.0/24 is shared/flat and not the routed segments). Paired and addressed them: node1 eth1=192.168.10.1/24 (lan-a, toward node2) and eth2=192.168.20.1/24 (lan-b, toward node3); node2 ens7=192.168.10.2/24; node3 ens7=192.168.20.2/24, with static routes on node2/node3 via node1. Configured this persistently (OpenWrt UCI network on node1, /etc/network/interfaces.d on node2/node3 since they're Ubuntu 16.04 with ifupdown). Added OpenWrt firewall zones 'lana' and 'lanb' (default forward=REJECT) plus a single explicit rule permitting only tcp/5432 from lana to lanb. Verified: node2->node3:5432 succeeds, node2->node3:8080 refused, node3->node2:5432 refused. Then ran the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, node2, node3), proving changed boot_id/reset uptime after each reboot and re-verifying the interface config, routes, and full three-case connectivity policy recovered after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network state and OpenWrt UCI network/firewall config
Identified spare NICs (node1 eth1/eth2, node2/node3 ens7) as the true lan-a/lan-b links
Assigned and tested static IPs to determine correct eth1<->node2 and eth2<->node3 pairing
Added static routes on node2 and node3 for cross-subnet reachability via node1
Configured node1 UCI network interfaces 'lana' and 'lanb' persistently and reloaded network service
Added OpenWrt firewall zones lana/lanb (forward=REJECT default) and one rule permitting tcp/5432 lana->lanb, committed and reloaded firewall
Verified policy: node2->node3:5432 allowed, node2->node3:8080 refused, node3->node2:5432 refused
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3, polling each until exec access returned
Proved changed boot_id and reset uptime for each node post-reboot
Re-verified persisted interface/firewall config and full connectivity policy after each node's restart
Cleaned up temporary test listeners on node2/node3

evidence.summary: Static IPs and routes configured persistently via UCI (node1) and ifupdown (node2/node3)

evidence.requirement: Firewall policy: permit only node2->node3 tcp/5432, refuse all else both directions
evidence.summary: UCI firewall zones+rule committed/reloaded; live test proved allow on 5432, reject on 8080 and reject on reverse direction

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Boot_id e1cc2200...->90ed18ff..., uptime reset to 0m; UCI firewall/network config and full connectivity policy confirmed intact post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Boot_id afd04380...->c416bd45..., uptime reset to 0m; ens7 static IP/route persisted via ifupdown; node2->node3:5432 confirmed working post-reboot

evidence.summary: Boot_id 8660e8f0...->52a2c7c0..., uptime reset to 0m; ens7 config persisted; final full policy verification (allow 5432, block 8080, block reverse) passed post-reboot
